text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that does not focus on land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction. Instead, it assesses current soil conservation status and identifies areas needing land degradation neutrality (LDN) planning using existing land use data (COS2015) and soil erosion modeling. It uses current LULC as input—not to predict or simulate future LULC change—and does not implement any future LULC scenarios. While it operates at a national scale (Portugal) and includes spatial modeling, it fails the core inclusion criterion that the primary focus must be LULC prediction/simulation. Additionally, it does not produce mapped LULC projections or compare future LULC scenarios.)
